page.layout: One bookbinding spine, photographed upright on a dark background. From top to bottom: five gold-tooled panels with a red oval onlay, one above the title label; the title label in the second panel position, with two lines of gold lettering; and at the foot a plain panel with the date.
page.notes: No printed page is visible, only the spine of the binding. The title lines are gold-tooled on the leather label and are read from the spine, not from a title page. The date at the foot is set in old-style figures and is copied as shown. The top and foot of the spine are cropped by the photograph. The dark background and the spine edges are not transcribed.
